notesEn: 0.3.65: Refresh feedback - the top "Re-check" now shows a success/failure toast; the five card "Refresh" buttons switch to "Refreshing..." while running and restore afterwards, with setBusy added to the three load() functions that never drove busy. Front-end interaction only; no behaviour or data changes.
notes: 0.3.65: 刷新按钮反馈——顶部「重新检测」成功/失败都弹 toast；五个卡片「刷新」按钮点击变「刷新中…」并禁用、结束恢复，其中同步冲突/同步内容/问题反馈三处 load 原本没驱动 busy，已补齐 setBusy。纯前端交互修复，行为与数据不变。
